basic_info.description: Stately Parkside home with two levels of living space above the garage and panoramic views of the Ocean from the top level. With a classic Full-Five floorplan and an abundance of charm from the 1920's, this is the home you have been waiting for. Situated on a lovely block and filled with natural light, this residence has hardwood floors with inlay that begin at the formal entry. The living room has an arched entryway, a curved ceiling and a wood burning fireplace. The formal dining room has a coved ceiling and period trimwork. The kitchen opens to the breakfast room, both of which are illuminated from the lightwell. The main level is completed by two generous sized bedrooms and a full bath with a tub & shower stall. The top level has a sitting room which looks onto the Pacific Ocean and gravitates to an enormous primary suite with a balcony, full bath and views. On the ground level you will find a bedroom, full bath, reading room, garage and access to a low maintenance terraced yard.
